summary.gameLoopReview: No context/GAME_LOOP.md exists, so the game-loop lens used live code and task-board evidence. The highest-confidence work this pass is protocol reliability that protects future game sessions; product/game deferred items remain real but larger than the verified protocol defects discovered during /start.
summary.premiseVerification: Every shipped item was reproduced against the live worktree: startup brief validation failed before repair; check-windows-hide failed before repair; verify-plan-mode falsely warned for Codex before repair; compact-handoff unicode smoke and model-router sanitization were missing in the dirty diff before restoration. The duplicate timer candidate was rejected-on-verification rather than shipped because the second setup appears to be a restart path that clears the first timer.

candidates.title: Startup brief canonical surface regression
candidates.why: The official /start path rendered a brief that failed its own canonical validator because raw genius-list output was written as plain numbered rows and HUMAN PRESSURE vanished when no pressure item existed. That breaks multi-agent continuity before any gameplay work starts.
candidates.recipe: Import the existing startup-brief box helpers in scripts/render-startup-brief.mjs, normalize generated genius-list output with normalizeGeniusBlock(), and always render renderHumanPressureBlock() with an honest empty state.
candidates.evidence: Before repair, node scripts/validate-brief-format.mjs docs/STARTUP_BRIEF.md failed missing GENIUS HIT LIST and HUMAN PRESSURE. After repair, brief validation passes and tests/startup-brief-boxes.test.js passes 5/5.

L1.recipe: Wrap raw genius output in a box.

L2.recipe: Normalize genius output and render the human-pressure empty state through reusable helpers.

L3.recipe: Add full render + validator regression coverage for the complete startup brief.

candidates.title: Model-router Unicode transport regression
candidates.why: The dirty worktree removed sanitizeUnicodeScalars(), safeJsonStringify(), and the compact-handoff --smoke-unicode path. That reopens the exact malformed UTF-16 failure class that previously broke handoff compression.
candidates.recipe: Restore recursive Unicode scalar sanitization at the model-router serialization chokepoints and restore the compact-handoff Unicode smoke that proves lone surrogates cannot reach provider payloads.
candidates.evidence: node scripts/compact-handoff.mjs --smoke-unicode passes, and focused compact-handoff/startup brief tests pass 6/6.

L2.recipe: Restore all model-router JSON chokepoints plus the compact-handoff smoke.

L3.recipe: Add shared malformed-Unicode tests for raw Anthropic calls, batch calls, and cache-key generation.

candidates.title: Codex plan-mode truth regression
candidates.why: Codex sessions were again warned to run Claude Code /model opusplan despite the session lock identifying agent: codex. That is an observability-honesty issue and wastes every Codex /start.
candidates.recipe: Restore session-agent detection in scripts/verify-plan-mode.mjs and stamp not_required for non-Claude agents into PROJECT_STATUS and context/.session-lock.
candidates.evidence: node scripts/verify-plan-mode.mjs --json returns status not_required, agent codex, and reason 'agent codex does not support Claude Code plan-mode'.

L2.recipe: Add focused regression coverage around Codex lock parsing and status stamping.

L3.recipe: Move plan-mode applicability into a shared agent-capability helper used by start and closeout.

candidates.title: Windows-hide closeout parity
candidates.why: The new Windows-hide guard correctly found a shell spawn in closeout-autopilot that was not explicitly hidden. Closeout is a hot path; it must not pop OS console windows during unattended sessions.
candidates.recipe: Route closeout-autopilot through lib/safe-spawn.mjs and add windowsHide:true to the shell:true options object so the guard can verify it locally.
candidates.evidence: node scripts/check-windows-hide.mjs --json now reports ok true, count 0.

L1.recipe: Add windowsHide:true to the flagged closeout spawn.

L2.recipe: Verify no direct child_process imports and no shell:true missing hide remain.

L3.recipe: Wire the guard into all local protocol validation surfaces.

candidates.title: Protocol drift covers Windows-hide enforcement
candidates.why: A repo could previously claim protocol drift 20/20 while missing the new window-storm guard or safe-spawn wrapper. That would make the protocol surface green while the founder-flagged Windows failure mode was unprotected.
candidates.recipe: Add check-windows-hide.mjs and lib/safe-spawn.mjs as required protocol-drift helpers, with the runtime shim and codemod as optional but tracked helpers.
candidates.evidence: npm run protocol:drift -- --json now reports 24/24 present, missingRequired 0, missingOptional 0.

L1.recipe: Add the guard to protocol drift.

L2.recipe: Track the guard, wrapper, shim, and codemod in protocol drift.

L3.recipe: Add a protocol drift test that fails if future Studio OS mandatory helpers are not represented.
